Machine Learning
A field of AI focusing on learning from data

Artificial Intelligence
Artificial intelligence is a broad field focused on creating intelligent systems capable of performing tasks that typically require human intelligence.<SEP>Artificial intelligence is a broad field that encompasses machine learning.

Natural Language Processing
Natural Language Processing is a field of computer science and artificial intelligence concerned with the interaction between computers and human language.<SEP>Natural language processing is a field of artificial intelligence that focuses on enabling computers to understand human language.

Computers
Computers are machines that can be programmed to carry out sequences of arithmetic or logical operations automatically.<SEP>Computers are machines that can be programmed to execute a sequence of instructions, and in this context, they are being enabled to understand text.

Text
Text is a form of communication that computers process through natural language processing.<SEP>Text is a form of written communication that computers can process and understand through natural language processing.

Deep Learning
Advanced ML using neural networks

Multiple Layers
Multiple layers refer to the stacked structure of neural networks in deep learning, enabling hierarchical feature extraction.<SEP>Multiple layers are a key characteristic of neural networks used in deep learning, enabling the processing of complex patterns.

Neural Networks
Neural networks are computational models inspired by the structure and function of biological neural networks, used in deep learning.<SEP>Neural networks are computational models inspired by the structure and function of biological neural networks, used in deep learning.
